posts.cooked:
Background: I’m opening a Gumroad store soon and i want to export sales data from Gumroad to Airtable for a little bit of flexibility when following up with customers.

Role: Looking for freelancers to help with sending data from Gumroad to my Airtable table. Data I’m looking to collect include email addresses, transaction date, transaction amount, product id, etc.

Previously worked with a freelancer before who setup a workflow that scammed me into thinking the automation worked, it in fact did not work. Either way, I’m starting from scratch again and would love to work with a freelancer who can get this done quickly. I don’t imagine this workflow being difficult. But if it is, I’d love to hear an easier version of this workflow that gives me the same result (so if anyone knows a better way to run this workflow, feel free to let me know via the Airtable form in the “Tell me about yourself” section).

Location: Remote

Budget: $1,000 (open to hearing what this should cost)

You can apply with this Airtable form below.
